events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict in Iran continues to escalate, with potential for further geopolitical instability in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further military action, which could have significant implications for the region.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to increased prices and volatility in the market. This could have a significant impact on the global economy, particularly on industries that are heavily reliant on oil. As such, it is recommended to buy the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) as a hedge against potential market downturn, and short the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) as oil prices are likely to increase.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further escalation of the conflict

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when oil prices stabilize
